parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const source = $('Webhook').first().json; const req = source.body?.args || source.body || source.args || source; const requestedStart = DateTime.fromISO(req.start_time).setZone('America/New_York'); const requestedEnd = requestedStart.plus({ minutes: 30 }); const durationMinutes = 30; const busy = $items('Get many events').map(i => i.json).filter(e => e && e.start && e.end).map(e => ({ start: DateTime.fromISO(e.start.dateTime || e.start.date || e.start).setZone('America/New_York'), end: DateTime.fromISO(e.end.dateTime || e.end.date || e.end).setZone('America/New_York') })); const isFree = (start, end) => !busy.some(block => start < block.end && end > block.start); const withinHours = requestedStart.weekday <= 5 && requestedStart.hour >= 9 && requestedEnd.hour + requestedEnd.minute / 60 <= 17; if (withinHours && isFree(requestedStart, requestedEnd)) return { success: true, available: true, start_time: requestedStart.toISO(), end_time: requestedEnd.toISO() }; const candidates = []; for (let offset = -3; offset <= 3; offset++) { const day = requestedStart.plus({ days: offset }).startOf('day'); if (day.weekday > 5) continue; const open = day.set({ hour: 9 }); const close = day.set({ hour: 17 }); for (let start = open; start.plus({ minutes: durationMinutes }) <= close; start = start.plus({ minutes: 30 })) { const end = start.plus({ minutes: durationMinutes }); if (isFree(start, end)) candidates.push({ start, end }); } } candidates.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.start.toMillis() - requestedStart.toMillis()) - Math.abs(b.start.toMillis() - requestedStart.toMillis()) || a.start.toMillis() - b.start.toMillis()); return { success: true, available: false, requested_start: requestedStart.toISO(), alternatives: candidates.slice(0, 3).map(slot => ({ start_time: slot.start.toISO(), end_time: slot.end.toISO() })) }; })() }}
